# Digital Health

> Rust crate of pure calculation functions for digital health KPIs —
> patient engagement/access, digital care operations/safety, and cost and
> revenue. Rate modules are `std`-only: `f64` in and out, `Option<f64>`
> wherever a denominator can be zero. Thirteen cost/revenue modules depend on
> `rusty-money`: `u32` counts and a `Money` amount in, `Result<Money,
> MoneyError>` out.

One module per metric topic. Five mirror a topic in the upstream [Digital
Health
Metrics](https://github.com/digital-health-metrics/digital-health-metrics)
project directly; fifty more cover well-evidenced metrics not yet in
that project, sourced independently. Every module has the same shape: what
the metric is, how it's calculated, why it matters, a worked example that
runs as a doctest, data sources and caveats, common pitfalls, and further
reading.

## Docs

- [Crate root](src/lib.rs): module index and a quickstart doctest
- [Specification contracts](spec/README.md): formula, signature, and
  `None`/`Err` condition for every function — the single source of truth
  for "what it computes"
- [README](README.md): install, quickstart, module index, testing
- [Skill](digital-health-skill/SKILL.md): how an AI agent should pick a
  function and read an `Option<f64>` or `Result<Money, MoneyError>` result
  in this crate

## Modules

- [Patient portal adoption rate](src/patient_portal_adoption_rate.rs):
  `registration_rate`, `activation_rate`, `active_use_rate` — three-stage
  funnel over `f64` counts, each `Option<f64>`
- [Telehealth visit rate](src/telehealth_visit_rate.rs):
  `telehealth_visit_rate`, `video_rate`, `telephone_rate`
- [Appointment no-show rate](src/appointment_no_show_rate.rs):
  `no_show_rate`, `late_cancellation_rate`, `combined_non_attendance_rate`
- [Remote patient monitoring adherence rate](src/remote_patient_monitoring_adherence_rate.rs):
  `monitoring_adherence_rate`, `billing_threshold_met_rate`
- [Telehealth technical failure rate](src/telehealth_technical_failure_rate.rs):
  `technical_failure_rate`, `rebooking_rate`
- [Patient self-scheduling rate](src/patient_self_scheduling_rate.rs):
  `self_scheduling_rate`, `same_day_self_scheduling_rate`
- [Digital intake form completion rate](src/digital_intake_form_completion_rate.rs):
  `intake_completion_rate`, `pre_visit_completion_rate`
- [PROM completion rate](src/prom_completion_rate.rs):
  `prom_completion_rate`, `digital_completion_share`
- [Digital therapeutic retention rate](src/digital_therapeutic_retention_rate.rs):
  `day_7_retention_rate`, `day_30_retention_rate`
- [Patient identity verification rate](src/patient_identity_verification_rate.rs):
  `verification_success_rate`, `step_up_verification_rate`
- [Net Promoter Score](src/net_promoter_score.rs):
  `net_promoter_score`, `survey_response_rate`
- [Digital access rate](src/digital_access_rate.rs):
  `digital_access_rate`, `access_parity_ratio`
- [Patient acquisition efficiency](src/patient_acquisition_efficiency.rs):
  `ltv_to_cac_ratio`, `marketing_efficiency_ratio`
- [Engagement Consistency Rate](src/engagement_consistency_rate.rs):
  `active_week_rate`, `dropout_rate`
- [Digital Literacy Rate](src/digital_literacy_rate.rs):
  `unassisted_completion_rate`, `assistance_rate`
- [Medication Adherence Rate](src/medication_adherence_rate.rs):
  `proportion_of_days_covered`, `adherent_patient_rate`
- [Active User Rate](src/active_user_rate.rs):
  `active_user_rate`, `stickiness_ratio`
- [Long-Term Retention Rate](src/long_term_retention_rate.rs):
  `day_60_retention_rate`, `day_90_retention_rate`
- [System Usability Scale](src/system_usability_scale.rs):
  `sus_score`, `mean_sus_score`
- [Clinical alert override rate](src/clinical_alert_override_rate.rs):
  `override_rate`, `documented_override_rate`
- [Digital referral turnaround time](src/digital_referral_turnaround_time.rs):
  `elapsed_days`, `hours_to_days`, `percentile`
- [Secure messaging response time](src/secure_messaging_response_time.rs):
  `response_hours`, `percentile`
- [E-prescribing transmission accuracy](src/e_prescribing_transmission_accuracy.rs):
  `first_pass_transmission_rate`, `pharmacy_callback_rate`
- [CPOE adoption rate](src/cpoe_adoption_rate.rs):
  `electronic_order_rate`, `verbal_order_rate`
- [Duplicate patient record rate](src/duplicate_patient_record_rate.rs):
  `duplicate_record_rate`, `resolved_duplicate_rate`
- [E-consult turnaround time](src/econsult_turnaround_time.rs):
  `elapsed_hours`, `percentile`
- [Medication reconciliation rate](src/medication_reconciliation_rate.rs):
  `admission_reconciliation_rate`, `discharge_reconciliation_rate`
- [Interoperability document exchange rate](src/interoperability_document_exchange_rate.rs):
  `exchange_success_rate`, `structured_data_parse_rate`
- [Clinical alert firing rate](src/clinical_alert_firing_rate.rs):
  `alert_firing_rate`, `high_severity_firing_share`
- [EHR system uptime rate](src/ehr_system_uptime_rate.rs):
  `uptime_rate`, `unplanned_downtime_share`
- [Digital referral acceptance rate](src/digital_referral_acceptance_rate.rs):

- [Triage accuracy rate](src/triage_accuracy_rate.rs):
  `triage_accuracy_rate`, `under_triage_rate`
- [Readmission rate](src/readmission_rate.rs):
  `readmission_rate`, `readmission_reduction`
- [Clinician documentation time](src/clinician_documentation_time.rs):

- [Biometric Improvement](src/biometric_improvement.rs):
  `estimated_a1c`, `biometric_reduction`, `target_attainment_rate`

  `reach_rate`, `adoption_rate`, `implementation_fidelity_rate`, `maintenance_rate`
- [No-show lost revenue](src/no_show_lost_revenue.rs) (`Money`, not `f64`):

- [Remote patient monitoring billing revenue](src/remote_patient_monitoring_billing_revenue.rs)

- [Telehealth cost avoidance](src/telehealth_cost_avoidance.rs) (`Money`, not

- [Patient self-scheduling cost savings](src/patient_self_scheduling_cost_savings.rs)

- [E-consult cost avoidance](src/econsult_cost_avoidance.rs) (`Money`, not
  `f64`): `cost_avoided`, `net_savings`
- [Digital intake cost savings](src/digital_intake_cost_savings.rs) (`Money`,
  not `f64`): `staff_time_saved_cost`, `net_savings`
- [Duplicate record remediation cost](src/duplicate_record_remediation_cost.rs)
